jobs.title: VP, Data and Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we're the team behind Money Mart—Canada's largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

We've Got You Covered

Compensation Philosophy:
Our strategy is designed to attract and retain top talent by offering competitive, fair, and performance-driven rewards. We benchmark against the market, recognize strong performance and continuously evolve to meet the needs of our people and our business.

Discretionary Annual Bonus:
Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

Comprehensive Benefits:
Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

Retirement Plans:
Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you're set for the long haul.

Hybrid Work Environment:
Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office.

Perks and Rewards:
Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

The Job:
Vice President, Data and Enterprise Architecture

What You'll Do

The Vice President, Data and Enterprise Architecture, is responsible for leading Momentum's business and technology on a unified path towards an enterprise target architecture that enables innovation, scalability, and sustainable business growth. This role defines and drives the strategic vision for data, integration, business architecture, and technology platforms —ensuring that architecture and technology investments accelerate business strategy, reduce costs, and position the organization for AI readiness.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of progressive technology leadership in enterprise architecture, data strategy, and platform modernization
Proven experience in rationalizing complex technology environments, reducing technical debt, and delivering measurable cost efficiencies
Demonstrated success leading transformation of large-scale data and technology ecosystems in financial services or similarly regulated industries
Strong track record of building AI- and data-ready enterprise architectures
Experience marrying business architecture with future state architecture

Required Qualifications

Expertise in enterprise data architecture, governance, and analytics
Deep understanding of cloud-native design, integration, and modernization
Strategic ability to balance innovation, performance, and cost optimization
Knowledge of cybersecurity, compliance, and regulatory frameworks
Strong executive communication, influence, and leadership capabilities

Education

Required Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field

Desired Education

Master's degree in Data Science, Cloud Computing, or Enterprise Architecture

Professional Designations (Accreditations, Certificates, Licenses)

Desired Professional Designations

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification
CISSP / CISM (information security)
AWS, Azure, or GCP Cloud Architecture certifications

Committed to Equal Opportunity:

MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.

#JS

About MFSG – Our Commitment To Responsible Innovation

At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada's Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

This posting is for a current position within our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities.

We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

Joining MFSG means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

jobs.title: Vice President, Risk Business Management and Governance
jobs.description:
Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours

37.5

Line Of Business

Risk Management

Pay Details

$185,000 - $275,000 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

We are looking for a strategic and collaborative executive to lead the Risk Business Management and Governance function. As Vice President, Risk Business Management and Governance, you will integrate strategy and planning, financial management, business operations support and governance to strengthen execution, transparency and accountability across Risk Management.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Risk Management Transformation and Enablement, you will partner with Risk leaders and enterprise teams to translate priorities into clear plans, provide timely business insights and establish disciplined management routines. This is an opportunity to influence at scale in a complex, regulated and multi-jurisdictional environment.

Key Accountabilities

Lead Risk Management strategy and annual planning, translating enterprise and Risk priorities into clear objectives, plans and measurable outcomes.
Oversee transformation priorities and investments, supporting prioritization, sequencing, funding decisions and alignment across Risk.
Manage the Risk scorecard, consolidating performance measures, commitments, dependencies and outcomes for executive review.
Provide integrated business insights and recommendations to support strategic trade-offs, resource allocation and timely decision-making.
Lead performance reporting and workforce analytics, providing visibility into capacity, organizational trends and execution against priorities.
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, expense management and financial performance, including variance analysis, cost transparency and investment governance.
Lead business operations and administrative services that enable efficient and consistent execution across the function.
Oversee communications, colleague engagement and workplace requirements in partnership with enterprise teams.
Establish policy frameworks and operating guidance that clarify requirements, ownership and expected practices.
Lead governance disciplines spanning monitoring and testing, issue management, change governance and regulatory programs.
Oversee Business Continuity Management and data governance, including policy and standards, stewardship and data quality.
Create an integrated view of strategy, financials, operations, governance and execution to strengthen organizational discipline and accountability.
Build effective partnerships across Risk and enterprise functions, influencing outcomes through shared accountabilities.
Develop an inclusive, high-performing environment where different perspectives are valued and colleagues are empowered to deliver.

Key Partnerships

Risk Management leaders and teams across all Risk pillars.
Risk Management Transformation and Enablement leadership.
Enterprise partners across Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Data, Legal, Compliance, Communications, Corporate Real Estate and shared services.
Senior executives, governance forums and program sponsors responsible for strategic prioritization and decision-making.

What You Bring

Significant progressive leadership experience in business management, strategy, finance, operations, governance, risk management or enterprise transformation.
Experience leading integrated business planning, executive reporting, scorecards and management routines in a large, complex organization.
Strong financial management experience, including budgeting, forecasting, expense oversight, investment governance and performance analysis.
Experience with workforce analytics, organizational planning, business operations, communications, colleague engagement and workplace coordination.
Strong knowledge of governance disciplines, including monitoring and testing, issue management, change governance, regulatory programs, business continuity, policy frameworks and data stewardship.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information, identify themes and trade-offs, and provide clear recommendations to senior executives.
Strong judgment and the ability to influence, constructively challenge and build alignment across a matrixed organization.
Strong executive communication, organizational awareness and the ability to operate effectively in a highly regulated environment.
Inclusive leadership skills and a commitment to creating an environment where people with different backgrounds and perspectives can contribute and succeed.
A post-secondary degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. Advanced education or relevant professional credentials may be an asset but are not required.

We recognize that strong candidates may bring different combinations of education, career paths and lived experience. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology and Transformation Risk
jobs.description:
Experience Aviva

Together, we are Aviva.

Our values of Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence guide how we show up for each other and our customers. At Aviva Canada, we put people first through a culture built on inclusion, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The Opportunit
y

The VP Technology and Transformation Risk is a senior member of the Canada Risk function, responsible for providing independent second line oversight and challenge across Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks. The role supports the effective management of these risks across Aviva Canada, helping ensure business objectives can be delivered within the Aviva Canada’s risk appetite framework and regulatory expectations.

The role partners closely with Group and local stakeholders to provide independent risk advice, oversight and challenge, supporting the ongoing development of risk management practices and frameworks across technology and transformation activities.

Risks within the role holder's remit include Cyber Risk, Data Risk, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Emerging Technology Risk and other IT risks.

The role leads specialist risk teams and works closely with colleagues across Risk, Technology, Operations and Transformation functions to provide insight on emerging risks, monitor risk exposures, and support consistent application of Aviva Canada and Group policies and standards.

What You'll Do

Provide independent second line oversight and challenge of Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks across the Group.
Partner with senior leaders within Technology, Operations, Customer & Marketing and Transformation functions to support effective risk management and informed decision-making.
Monitor and assess technology and transformation risk exposures, providing insights and recommendations to senior management and risk committees.
Support the development, maintenance and implementation of Aviva Canada and Group risk frameworks, policies, standards and risk appetite measures relating to Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks
Contribute to risk reporting and analysis provided to Board Risk Committee and Executive Committees as required.
Provide independent review and challenge of significant technology and transformation initiatives, including major change programs and strategic investments
Support regulatory engagement activities and the provision of evidence relating to Technology, Cyber, Data and Transformation risk management practices.
Oversee the identification and assessment of technology concentration, critical dependency and third-party risks across key platforms, suppliers and services.
Monitor emerging technology developments and evolving risk trends, providing thought leadership and practical guidance to business stakeholders
Promote consistency in the application of risk policies, frameworks and methodologies across Aviva Canada.
Lead and develop specialist risk teams, creating a high-performance culture and strengthening risk expertise across Technology and Transformation disciplines.
Contribute to the development and execution of the wider Risk Function strategy and priorities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives across the Risk Function, including the adoption of data, technology and agile ways of working.

What You'll Bring

A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Business, or a related field.
15+ years of experience in data governance, data management, analytics, or a related discipline.
Relevant Insurance qualifications and/or Risk professional qualifications, CRM, CRMP, FRM, PRM or equivalent
Significant experience in enterprise risk management within a regulated financial services or insurance environment, including application of the Three Lines of Defense model
Deep expertise in Technology, Cyber, Data, AI, Operational Resilience and Third-Party Risk oversight and governance
Proven oversight of large-scale transformation and change programs, including complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
Experience partnering with senior executives (CIO, COO, business leaders) and influencing strategic decisions
Strong people leadership experience, including building, leading and developing high-performing specialist teams
Experience engaging with regulators, audit functions, executive committees and board-level stakeholders on risk matters.

What You'll Get

Competitive executive compensation package, including annual incentive opportunities.
Comprehensive pension and retirement savings programs.
Flexible hybrid work model.
Industry-leading health and wellness benefits.
Professional development and executive leadership growth opportunities.
Inclusive employee resource groups and diversity initiatives.
Volunteer opportunities and community impact programs.
Competitive vacation and wellness offerings.

This job advertisement is for an existing vacancy which has been posted both internally & externally.

If you require an accommodation during the interview or hiring process, please contact your Aviva Talent Acquisition Partner so that an appropriate accommodation can be arranged.

jobs.title: Finance Director (CFO)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Finance Director (CFO) based in Canada.

This senior finance leadership role offers the opportunity to act as a strategic business partner to the CEO within a growing international technology environment. You will oversee core financial operations while using financial insights to guide growth, profitability, and commercial decisions. The role spans budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, reporting, financial modeling, treasury, accounting, and international compliance. You will work across multiple currencies and jurisdictions, providing visibility into margins, liquidity, and key business performance drivers. The position combines strategic leadership with a hands-on, entrepreneurial approach to building scalable finance processes and controls. You will also collaborate closely with commercial, operational, legal, HR, and compliance teams to support sustainable business growth.

Accountabilities

Partner with the CEO to oversee financial operations, including budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial reporting.
Lead the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and monitor performance against key KPIs.
Provide actionable financial analysis and recommendations to support strategic decisions and business growth.
Build financial models for business cases, new markets, and commercial opportunities, with clear visibility into margins and profitability drivers.
Oversee accounting, treasury, and payment operations across multiple currencies and jurisdictions.
Manage liquidity, foreign exchange exposure, settlements, receivables, and other key financial flows.
Ensure compliance with international accounting standards, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
Coordinate with auditors and external advisors on financial, tax, and regulatory matters.
Partner with Sales, Operations, Routing, HR, Legal, and Compliance teams to evaluate financial risks and improve profitability and operational efficiency.
Build and continuously improve finance processes, internal controls, systems, and team capabilities.

Requirements

7+ years of professional finance experience, including at least 3 years in a senior finance leadership position such as Finance Director, Head of Finance, CFO, or equivalent.
Entrepreneurial experience in scale-ups, founder-led companies, business ownership, P&L management, or building a finance function from the ground up.
Strong knowledge of IFRS and international taxation, with experience managing multi-entity, multi-currency, and cross-border operations.
Strong financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear business recommendations.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial topics clearly to teams, leadership, and shareholders.
Hands-on, ownership-oriented approach with the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced and ambiguous environments.
Confidence using financial data to challenge assumptions and support business decisions.
Experience in telecom, payments, fintech, or other high-volume transactional businesses is a plus.
Experience with crypto, including crypto payments, treasury, or accounting, is advantageous.
Native or fluent Russian is mandatory.
English proficiency at C1 level or above is mandatory.

Benefits

Key finance leadership role with direct influence on business growth and strategy.
Close strategic partnership with the CEO.
Opportunity to shape and develop the finance function, including processes, controls, systems, and team capabilities.
International and cross-border business environment.
Opportunity to work across financial operations, commercial strategy, treasury, and business planning.

jobs.title: Program Leader in AI- First Marketing Strategy for Kellogg Executive Education.
jobs.description:
Information about the Organization:

Eruditus and its sister company Emeritus provide Small Private Online Courses (SPOCs) to students all over the world. We have partnered with top schools across the globe, such as Columbia Business School, The Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth, MIT, Wharton, London Business School, Cambridge, and UC Berkeley Haas School of Business, to provide condensed, intense, practical, and convenient programs, which can either be conducted completely or partially online.
EMERITUS enables working professionals who cannot enroll in full-time courses to access a top-tier, affordable education that will give them the skills needed to be the business leaders of tomorrow. The Emeritus and Eruditus global team include 1,000+ employees located in the US, Dubai, Mexico, India, China, and Singapore.

Information about the Program Leader role:

Emeritus is seeking a Program Leader
for the Kellogg Executive Education Program AI-First Marketing Strategy: Executing Intelligent Systems for Growth Live Online Program .
The Program Leader is a subject matter expert that serves as the front-line academic support for learners in the course, supporting the delivery of a high-impact, 8-weeks online program. The Program Leader will be working closely with the Emeritus Academic Delivery Team. Candidates must have industry experience and demonstrated knowledge of the course subject area. They will guide learners through complex topics like AI-driven strategies, frameworks, and challenges in real-world contexts.
This is a great role for someone who wants work flexibility and the chance to diversify their resume with consultancy and teaching experience. This is an independent contractor position in a remote setting.

Responsibilities of the Program Leader role:

Facilitate weekly live sessions and moderate required discussion boards

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we're the team behind Money Mart—Canada's largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

We've Got You Covered

Compensation Philosophy:
Our strategy is designed to attract and retain top talent by offering competitive, fair, and performance-driven rewards. We benchmark against the market, recognize strong performance and continuously evolve to meet the needs of our people and our business.

Discretionary Annual Bonus:
Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

Comprehensive Benefits:
Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

Retirement Plans:
Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you're set for the long haul.

Hybrid Work Environment:
Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office.

Perks and Rewards:
Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

The Job:
Vice President, Data and Enterprise Architecture

What You'll Do

The Vice President, Data and Enterprise Architecture, is responsible for leading Momentum's business and technology on a unified path towards an enterprise target architecture that enables innovation, scalability, and sustainable business growth. This role defines and drives the strategic vision for data, integration, business architecture, and technology platforms —ensuring that architecture and technology investments accelerate business strategy, reduce costs, and position the organization for AI readiness.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of progressive technology leadership in enterprise architecture, data strategy, and platform modernization
Proven experience in rationalizing complex technology environments, reducing technical debt, and delivering measurable cost efficiencies
Demonstrated success leading transformation of large-scale data and technology ecosystems in financial services or similarly regulated industries
Strong track record of building AI- and data-ready enterprise architectures
Experience marrying business architecture with future state architecture

Required Qualifications

Expertise in enterprise data architecture, governance, and analytics
Deep understanding of cloud-native design, integration, and modernization
Strategic ability to balance innovation, performance, and cost optimization
Knowledge of cybersecurity, compliance, and regulatory frameworks
Strong executive communication, influence, and leadership capabilities

Education

Required Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field

Desired Education

Master's degree in Data Science, Cloud Computing, or Enterprise Architecture

Professional Designations (Accreditations, Certificates, Licenses)

Desired Professional Designations

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification
CISSP / CISM (information security)
AWS, Azure, or GCP Cloud Architecture certifications

Committed to Equal Opportunity:

MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.

#JS

About MFSG – Our Commitment To Responsible Innovation

At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada's Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

This posting is for a current position within our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities.

We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

Joining MFSG means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Technology and Transformation Risk
new_jobs.description:
Experience Aviva

Together, we are Aviva.

Our values of Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence guide how we show up for each other and our customers. At Aviva Canada, we put people first through a culture built on inclusion, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The Opportunit
y

The VP Technology and Transformation Risk is a senior member of the Canada Risk function, responsible for providing independent second line oversight and challenge across Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks. The role supports the effective management of these risks across Aviva Canada, helping ensure business objectives can be delivered within the Aviva Canada’s risk appetite framework and regulatory expectations.

The role partners closely with Group and local stakeholders to provide independent risk advice, oversight and challenge, supporting the ongoing development of risk management practices and frameworks across technology and transformation activities.

Risks within the role holder's remit include Cyber Risk, Data Risk, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Emerging Technology Risk and other IT risks.

The role leads specialist risk teams and works closely with colleagues across Risk, Technology, Operations and Transformation functions to provide insight on emerging risks, monitor risk exposures, and support consistent application of Aviva Canada and Group policies and standards.

What You'll Do

Provide independent second line oversight and challenge of Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks across the Group.
Partner with senior leaders within Technology, Operations, Customer & Marketing and Transformation functions to support effective risk management and informed decision-making.
Monitor and assess technology and transformation risk exposures, providing insights and recommendations to senior management and risk committees.
Support the development, maintenance and implementation of Aviva Canada and Group risk frameworks, policies, standards and risk appetite measures relating to Technology, Data, Cyber, AI and Transformation risks
Contribute to risk reporting and analysis provided to Board Risk Committee and Executive Committees as required.
Provide independent review and challenge of significant technology and transformation initiatives, including major change programs and strategic investments
Support regulatory engagement activities and the provision of evidence relating to Technology, Cyber, Data and Transformation risk management practices.
Oversee the identification and assessment of technology concentration, critical dependency and third-party risks across key platforms, suppliers and services.
Monitor emerging technology developments and evolving risk trends, providing thought leadership and practical guidance to business stakeholders
Promote consistency in the application of risk policies, frameworks and methodologies across Aviva Canada.
Lead and develop specialist risk teams, creating a high-performance culture and strengthening risk expertise across Technology and Transformation disciplines.
Contribute to the development and execution of the wider Risk Function strategy and priorities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives across the Risk Function, including the adoption of data, technology and agile ways of working.

What You'll Bring

A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Business, or a related field.
15+ years of experience in data governance, data management, analytics, or a related discipline.
Relevant Insurance qualifications and/or Risk professional qualifications, CRM, CRMP, FRM, PRM or equivalent
Significant experience in enterprise risk management within a regulated financial services or insurance environment, including application of the Three Lines of Defense model
Deep expertise in Technology, Cyber, Data, AI, Operational Resilience and Third-Party Risk oversight and governance
Proven oversight of large-scale transformation and change programs, including complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
Experience partnering with senior executives (CIO, COO, business leaders) and influencing strategic decisions
Strong people leadership experience, including building, leading and developing high-performing specialist teams
Experience engaging with regulators, audit functions, executive committees and board-level stakeholders on risk matters.

What You'll Get

Competitive executive compensation package, including annual incentive opportunities.
Comprehensive pension and retirement savings programs.
Flexible hybrid work model.
Industry-leading health and wellness benefits.
Professional development and executive leadership growth opportunities.
Inclusive employee resource groups and diversity initiatives.
Volunteer opportunities and community impact programs.
Competitive vacation and wellness offerings.

This job advertisement is for an existing vacancy which has been posted both internally & externally.
